rationale: Pulsation synchronization mechanism is engineering, not biology. Frozen based on off-the-shelf components.

sensor.type: Flow sensor at proximal catheter (existing P-01 sensor)
sensor.rationale: Need 100 Hz to resolve cardiac pulsation (0.5-2 Hz fundamental, plus harmonics up to ~10 Hz)

phase_detector.algorithm: Bandpass filter 0.5-5 Hz + zero-crossing detector + phase-locked loop
phase_detector.outputs: Current phase angle (0-360 deg), instantaneous flow rate, predicted next-diastole timestamp
phase_detector.implementation: Software on controller MCU, runs at 100 Hz

actuator.type: Variable orifice valve (existing P-01 valve, repurposed)
actuator.synchronization_strategy: Open valve wider during diastole (low-flow phase, tau extended), close partially during systole (high-flow phase, drainage maintained).
actuator.rationale: 10 Hz valve update is sufficient to track 2 Hz pulsation (5x oversampling)

controller_tuning.rationale: Compensate for actuator delay (1 sec per spec) and fluid transport delay (~50 ms).

what_is_frozen: The mechanism architecture (sensor -> phase detector -> synchronized actuator). Reuses P-01 hardware.
what_is_NOT_frozen: Phase lead tuning constant. Must be measured on bench.
constitutional_basis: Article XXVII — phase lead is MODEL_DERIVED with explicit provenance. Article XXVIII — frozen architecture does not promote to VALIDATED.
